included: every regular file recursively under retained evidence root except output_filename
path_rules: sort by unsigned UTF-8 path bytes
tree_preimage: For each sorted entry, UTF-8 bytes: <sha256><two ASCII spaces><path><LF>; concatenate without header.

manifest_object.algorithm: exact copy of this contract schema id

verification: After atomic manifest write, independently reopen every entry without following symlinks, verify type/bytes/hash, reconstruct preimage, and compare tree digest.
operator_status_capture: retain raw stdout bytes and SHA-256 before experiment; rerun exact argv at closeout and require byte-for-byte and digest equality
baseline_status_capture: same command/byte rule; baseline must be zero bytes before and after
cleanup_gate: No disposable output may be deleted until independent evidence manifest verification passes. Retained evidence root is never automatically deleted.
